single.text: one solution in one slot; a record writes it as branch: null

line_param_order.text: slots follow the parameter along the orientation of the linear input on its carrier line, first is the smaller; slots are fixed on the carrier before the part filter; a double root fills both slots

circle_side.text: first lies to the left of the directed segment from the first centre to the second ((c2 - c1) x (X - c1) > 0), second to the right; a double root fills both slots

other_than.text: one slot: the solution of the base pair other than the explicit point argument known; tangency at known gives known; known not among the solutions gives branch_absent

tangent_side.text: tangents from a point: tangent.1 and touch.1 lie to the left of the ray from the point to the centre, tangent.2 and touch.2 to the right; a point on the circle fills both slots with the tangent at it (multiplicity 2), directions continuous with the outside case; a point inside gives point_inside

bisector_kind.text: bisectors of two lines: internal has direction normalize(d1 + d2), external is internal turned by +90 degrees; for parallel lines the slot whose direction sum is not zero is the midline, the other is parallel (coincident for one line)

vertex_index.text: a polygon and its parts: polygon, side.i from vertex.i to vertex.(i + 1) (side.n closes), vertex.k, counted from one; an image keeps vertex.k as the image of vertex.k without normalizing the orientation

sector_sides.text: line and sector: arc.1, arc.2 lie on the arc in the order of the line parameter (slots fixed on the carrier circle before the part filters), side.1 on the radius from c to S0, side.2 on the radius from c to S1

nearest_to.text: one slot: of the solutions of the base pair (in the order of its policy, after the part filters) the one nearest to the point near by hypot; a distance within tol.decide of the best keeps the earlier solution
